props.gloss_en: Shmuel set against each other: it is written 'Who makes Ash, Kesil and Kima' (Job 9:9), and it is written 'Who makes Kima and Kesil' (Amos 5:8) -- how so?
were it not for the heat of Kesil, the world would not endure because of the cold of Kima
and were it not for the cold of Kima, the world would not endure because of the heat of Kesil
and it is received: were it not that the tail of Scorpio lies in the River of Fire, no one stung by a scorpion would live
and that is what the Merciful One said to Job: 'can you bind the chains of Kima or loosen the cords of Kesil?' (Job 38:31)
what is Kima? Shmuel: about a hundred (kemeah) stars
some say they are gathered together
and some say they are scattered
what is Ash? Rav Yehuda: Yota
what is Yota? some say: the tail of the ram
and some say: the head of the calf
as it is written 'and Ayish with her children' (Job 38:32) -- evidently she is lacking, and appears as if torn off and attached
and that she (Ayish) goes after her (Kima) -- she is saying to her: give me my children
for when the Holy One sought to bring a flood on the world, He took two stars from Kima and brought the flood
and when He sought to stop it up, He took two stars from Ayish and stopped it up
Rav Nachman: the Holy One will in the future return them to her
as it says: 'and Ayish -- over her children she will be consoled' (Job 38:32)
